document.title: Work Queue Roadmap
document.authority: human-readable roadmap is authoritative for planned System direction represented in this record

verifiedOrDocumentedCapabilities: Task creation, assignment, filtering, tracking, updating, and completion
Google Sheets-backed task and assignment data
Employee records used for assignee selection
Completed Jobs/history capability to some extent
Inventory-related completion can create an Inventory_Holder_Event
knownGaps: No reliable current-user identity in the running application
No complete employee My Work / Available Work participation model
Pending work and supervisor-review routing incomplete
Inventory holder event does not yet complete employee-cart-to-holder inventory transfer
QR reporting and OpenAI-assisted validation not implemented
Building map/location model incomplete for target use

targetState.summary: A role-aware operational work system with identity, controlled supervisor review, employee participation, schedule context, employee-profile linkage, real inventory propagation, structured evidence, QR reporting, bounded AI validation, recurring work, searchable history, printable reporting, paperwork translation, location intelligence, and maintainable administration.
